name: Hatchable
description:
Hatchable turns your conversations with Claude into real apps that live on the web. You describe what you want in plain words, and Claude builds it and puts it online at its own web address. No coding, no setup, nothing to install.

Everything a real app needs is included:

- A place to store your data, like signups, orders, bookings, or anything else your app collects

- Sign-in for your users

- A live web address you can open on any device and share with anyone with custom domains

- Automatic emails and scheduled tasks, like a weekly summary or a reminder

- A dashboard where you can see your app, your data, and everything Claude built

Want changes? Just ask. Claude updates your live app in seconds, checks that it works, and fixes anything that breaks, all in the same conversation.

People use Hatchable for booking pages, signup and intake forms, club and community sites, small business tools, dashboards, and ideas they want to try for real instead of just talking about.  It's also great when you just need a database for Claude to store things in and access.

Connect your Hatchable account and describe your first app. It's free to try.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hatchable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hatchable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hatchable.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hatchable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hatchable lists 34 MCP tools, including create_preview_link, create_project, delete_file, deploy, dry_run_deploy, execute_sql, fork_project, get_deployment, get_project, get_schema, grep, and import_file_from_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hatchable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hatchable in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Hatchable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hatchable is developed by Hatchable. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
